datasets.name: ds_orders
queryLines: SELECT order_id, order_date, order_ts, hour(order_ts) AS order_hour,
date_format(order_ts, 'E') AS weekday, delivery_district, restaurant_name, cuisine, payment_method,
CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late_flag,
CASE WHEN is_late THEN 'Late' ELSE 'On time' END AS delivery_status,
CASE WHEN delay_minutes <= -10 THEN '1. 10+ min early' WHEN delay_minutes <= 0 THEN '2. On time'
WHEN delay_minutes <= 5 THEN '3. 1-5 min late' WHEN delay_minutes <= 10 THEN '4. 6-10 min late'
WHEN delay_minutes <= 15 THEN '5. 11-15 min late' ELSE '6. 16+ min late' END AS delay_bucket,
CASE WHEN is_late THEN delay_minutes END AS delay_if_late,

datasets.name: ds_restaurant_scorecard
queryLines: SELECT restaurant_name, cuisine, count(*) AS orders, round(sum(total_amount_rsd)) AS revenue_rsd,
round(avg(total_amount_rsd)) AS avg_order_rsd, round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS late_pct,
FROM gold.deliveries GROUP BY restaurant_name, cuisine

queryLines: SELECT window_start, delivery_district, deliveries, avg_delivery_minutes, late_deliveries,
